PURPOSE: determine whether the candidate maturity M = 30 CALENDAR days is sufficiently close to the historical long-lag source regime

NAMING.why: a ~900-day vintage is very mature, but 'unquestionably settled' would itself be an unproven claim

1_MATURITY_CLOCK.rule: session D reaches maturity M at D + M calendar days
1_MATURITY_CLOCK.why_not_business_days: there is no basis for tying a vendor revision/settlement process to a trading-session count, and the existing lag census is itself built on calendar-day age

MONTH_END_TRIGGER.admissible_X_sessions: session_date <= E - M calendar days AND an authoritative maturity vintage exists
MONTH_END_TRIGGER.later_backfill: NEVER rewrites an old NO_LOOK / LOOK record

2_LONG_LAG_REFERENCE_SELECTION.selection: the session whose original ingest lag is CLOSEST to the corpus median lag

SELECTED.tie_note: 2024-02-23 also sat at |lag-median| = 0.5; the earlier session_date rule chose 2024-02-22

2_LONG_LAG_REFERENCE_SELECTION.independence: the selection rule uses only ARCHIVE METADATA and cannot see any revision result

3_REVISION_METRIC.primary_population: the frozen 476 cohort — because the replication estimand is the 476

ticker_to_key_mapping.VERIFIED: 503 lineage securities map to exactly 476 frozen-cohort keys

definitions.common_bar_OHLCV_revision_rate: (# common minute keys where ANY of o/h/l/c/v changed) / (# common minute keys)
definitions.p95_relative_close_revision: Hyndman-Fan Type 7 p95 of |close_new - close_old| / |close_old| over finite common bars with close_old != 0

3_REVISION_METRIC.why_excluded: these are HARD FAILURE / SOURCE_REGIME_HOLD conditions, not quantities to be averaged away

4_T30_PRIMARY_SESSIONS.rule: of the five sessions with an authoritative vintage at <= T+7, take the three with the SMALLEST original ingest lag, so revision is measured from the earliest available state
4_T30_PRIMARY_SESSIONS.2026_08_24_T7_vintage: the existing T+7 diagnostic vintage is REPORT-ONLY as an intermediate curve point; it does NOT replace the T+1 baseline in the primary comparison
4_T30_PRIMARY_SESSIONS.completion: all three primary T+30 measurements can only complete after 2026-09-23

5_QUALIFICATION_CRITERION.name: REFERENCE_NONEXCEEDANCE
5_QUALIFICATION_CRITERION.R_REF: the frozen 3-vector measured on the LONG_LAG_REFERENCE session
5_QUALIFICATION_CRITERION.R_30_MED: component-wise median of R across the three T+30 sessions
5_QUALIFICATION_CRITERION.RULE: T+30 QUALIFIES iff R_30_MED <= R_REF component-wise on ALL THREE components
5_QUALIFICATION_CRITERION.ON_FAILURE: T+30 = NOT QUALIFIED. The threshold is NOT raised, the metric is NOT changed, and no session is dropped.
5_QUALIFICATION_CRITERION.NO_INVENTED_TOLERANCE: no 5%, no 2x, no 0.1pp — the corpus supplies its own comparison vector
5_QUALIFICATION_CRITERION.PERMITTED_RESULT_WORDING: T+30 met / did not meet the preregistered long-lag reference nonexceedance criterion
5_QUALIFICATION_CRITERION.ACKNOWLEDGED_WEAKNESS: R_REF rests on ONE long-lag session. That weakness is not removed by this design; it is stated.

GOVERNANCE_EFFECT: in September there is no remaining freedom over the metric, the tolerance, or the choice of the three sessions. The long-lag refetch supplies the threshold vector BEFORE any T+30 result is read.
